name: Los Justicieros

offices.label: Los Justicieros
offices.address: 10880 Wilshire Blvd Ste 2100, Los Angeles, CA 90024, USA

about: Los Justicieros is a personal injury firm with a single office in Los Angeles.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, partial
G1.evidence: None of the 1 attorneys this firm names could be found in the State Bar of California's register, so there is nothing here to clear or to fault.
G1.unresolvable: The register returns nothing for any name this firm publishes, and an empty search does not say whether the licence is missing or the name is

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, partial
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names could be identified in the register, so no disciplinary record could be looked up either.
G2.unresolvable: With no attorney identified in the register, there is no disciplinary record to find or to fail to find

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 0 named attorneys published, and 1 more person in roles the firm states are not a lawyer's.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 259 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2015-05-11, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the results page served 3666 characters of text and no figure or mention of a settlement, verdict or recovery, so there was nothing on it to count. Whether the results are held back from the served HTML or the page carries none is not something this check can tell.

score.verdict: 2 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar B in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
